definitions.gloss: first issue; inaugural issue; premiere issue
definitions.explanation: The very first published issue of a magazine, newspaper, journal, or other periodical publication.

examples.japanese: {創刊号|そうかんごう}を{手|て}に{入|い}れた。
examples.english: I got hold of the first issue.

examples.japanese: この{雑誌|ざっし}の{創刊号|そうかんごう}は{1985年|せんきゅうひゃくはちじゅうごねん}に{発行|はっこう}された。
examples.english: The first issue of this magazine was published in 1985.

examples.japanese: {創刊号|そうかんごう}から{最新号|さいしんごう}まで{全|すべ}て{揃|そろ}えているコレクターもいる。
examples.english: There are collectors who have every issue from the first to the latest.

notes:
Composed of {創刊|そうかん} (first publication, founding of a periodical) + {号|ごう} (issue number). Refers specifically to the first edition of a periodical.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {創刊号|そうかんごう}を{発行|はっこう}する: to publish the inaugural issue
- {創刊号|そうかんごう}から{読|よ}む: to read from the first issue
- {創刊号|そうかんごう}{特別|とくべつ}{付録|ふろく}: first-issue special supplement

RELATED WORDS:
- {最新号|さいしんごう}: the latest issue
- {休刊|きゅうかん}: suspension of publication
- {廃刊|はいかん}: discontinuation of publication
- {復刊|ふっかん}: resumption of publication
- {創刊|そうかん}: the act of founding/launching a periodical

USAGE:
{創刊号|そうかんごう} of popular magazines often become valuable collectibles. Many magazines offer special prices or {付録|ふろく} (supplements/freebies) with their {創刊号|そうかんごう} to attract initial readers.
